measurement_method: time.perf_counter via manifest.duration_seconds, clean (non-profiled) run, repeated 4 times

optimizations_applied.name: bulk states construction
optimizations_applied.description: Replaced installments.groupby('contract_id') + one group.to_dict('records') call per contract (thousands of separate pandas-level calls) with a single installments.to_dict('records') pass plus plain-Python grouping.
optimizations_applied.profiled_cost_before: ~9.2s of a ~34s cProfile run (largest hotspot found)

optimizations_applied.name: vectorized canonical table hashing
optimizations_applied.description: Replaced DataFrame.apply(..., axis=1) (one pandas Series built per row) with a single whole-array .astype(str) plus a plain Python list comprehension. Required reproducing a numpy fixed-width-string quirk (trailing NUL byte stripped from the null sentinel) that the original per-row cast had, to preserve the exact same hash.
optimizations_applied.profiled_cost_before: ~6.7s of a ~34s cProfile run (second-largest hotspot found)

optimizations_applied.name: manual month-arithmetic in installment scheduling
optimizations_applied.description: Replaced pd.DateOffset(months=k) (constructs a dateutil.relativedelta per installment) with a verified-equivalent manual year/month/day-clamp calculation. Verified identical to pd.DateOffset across 200,000 randomized (date, months) pairs before adopting.

optimizations_applied.name: head-index installment pruning
optimizations_applied.description: Tracks a per-contract head_index pointer into the (already due-date-sorted) open_installments list, advanced once fully-paid installments are permanently exhausted, so month-by-month scans only touch genuinely open installments instead of the contract's full original schedule. Required one narrow fix: account_monthly_snapshots.next_due_date's own (pre-existing, deliberately preserved) inclusive same-day-payoff quirk still reads the FULL installment list, not the pruned one - found via full-content diffing at sample scale, not by reasoning alone.

identified_but_not_optimized: Strict contract validation (~0.9s coarse) - a hard, non-negotiable gate, not touched.
Parquet write (~0.2s coarse) - small relative to other phases.
load_all_contracts() YAML parsing (~0.14s coarse) - one-time fixed cost, not part of the O(months x contracts) loop this phase targeted.
